blocks.html: Where two or more buildings that are single- or two-family detached or zero lot line residences are located on a zoning lot, the applicable minimum lot area requirement set forth in the table in this Section shall be multiplied by the number of such buildings on the zoning lot. For the purposes of applying such calculation, detached buildings that are permitted obstructions in a required rear yard or rear yard equivalent shall not be included.
